# Summary of Your Energy Supplier Letter

## What's Happening
Your fixed-rate energy deal ends on **30 September 2026**. After that date, unless you do something, you'll automatically switch to a more expensive standard variable tariff.

## Cost Increase (if you do nothing)
Your bills will go up by approximately **£294 per year**:
- **Electricity**: unit rate rises from 22.4p to 27.9p per kWh
- **Electricity standing charge**: rises from 48.2p to 61.5p per day
- **Gas**: unit rate rises from 5.9p to 7.1p per kWh
- **Gas standing charge**: rises from 29.1p to 32.4p per day

---

## What You Need to Do (Choose One)

### Option 1: Switch to Their 12-Month Fixed Tariff (No exit fee)
- Electricity: 24.1p per kWh + 52.0p daily standing charge
- Gas: 6.2p per kWh + 30.2p daily standing charge
- **Deadline**: Before 30 September (no exit fee to switch before this date)
- Note: Exit fee of £35 per fuel applies if you leave early, except in the final 49 days

### Option 2: Switch to a Different Supplier
- You can switch anytime
- Compare prices on any accredited price comparison website

### Option 3: Do Nothing
- You'll automatically move to the more expensive variable tariff on 1 October

---

## Additional Action Required
**Provide an up-to-date meter reading** (they haven't had an actual reading since 11 March, so your recent bills are estimates):
- Submit online via your account
- Use their automated telephone service
- Return the enclosed card

---

## Key Deadline: **30 September 2026**
